air_epa: EPA from the air yards alone. For completions this represents the actual value provided through the air. For incompletions this represents the hypothetical value that could've been added through the air if the pass was completed.
air_wpa: WPA through the air (same logic as air_epa).
air_yards: Distance in yards perpendicular to the line of scrimmage at where the targeted receiver either caught or didn't catch the ball.
assist_tackle_1_player_id: One of the players with a tackle assist.
assist_tackle_1_player_name: One of the players with a tackle assist.
assist_tackle_1_team: Team of one of the players with a tackle assist.
assist_tackle_2_player_id: One of the players with a tackle assist.
assist_tackle_2_player_name: One of the players with a tackle assist.
assist_tackle_2_team: Team of one of the players with a tackle assist.
assist_tackle_3_player_id: One of the players with a tackle assist.
assist_tackle_3_player_name: One of the players with a tackle assist.
assist_tackle_3_team: Team of one of the players with a tackle assist.
assist_tackle_4_player_id: One of the players with a tackle assist.
assist_tackle_4_player_name: One of the players with a tackle assist.
assist_tackle_4_team: Team of one of the players with a tackle assist.
away_coach: First and last name of the away team coach. (Source: Pro-Football-Reference).
away_score: Total points scored by the away team.
away_timeouts_remaining: Timeouts remaining in the half for the away team.
away_wp: Estimated win probability for the away team.
away_wp_post: Estimated win probability for the away team at the end of the play.
blocked_player_id: Player that blocked the punt or FG.
blocked_player_name: Player that blocked the punt or FG.
comp_air_epa: EPA from the air yards alone only for completions.
comp_yac_epa: EPA from the yards after catch alone only for completions.
cp: Indicating the probability for a complete pass based on comparable game situations.
cpoe: For a single pass play this is 1 - cp when the pass was completed or 0 - cp when the pass was incomplete. Analyzed for a whole game or season an indicator for the passer how much over or under expectation his completion percentage was.
date_pulled: Date the data was retrieved from the FTN Data API by nflverse jobs.
def_wp: Estimated win probability for the defteam.
defensive_extra_point_attempt: Defense was able to have an attempt on an extra point attempt, this results following a blocked attempt that the defense recovers the ball.
defensive_extra_point_conv: Defense successfully scored on an extra point attempt.
defensive_two_point_attempt: Defense was able to have an attempt on a two point conversion, this results following a turnover.
defensive_two_point_conv: Defense successfully scored on the two point conversion.
defteam_score: Score the defteam at the start of the play.
defteam_score_post: Score for the defteam at the end of the play.
defteam_timeouts_remaining: Number of timeouts remaining for the team on defense.
desc: Detailed string description for the given play.
div_game: Given game was a division game.
drive_end_transition: Indicating how the offense lost the ball.
drive_end_yard_line: Indicating where a given drive ended consisting of team half and yard line number.
drive_first_downs: Number of first downs in a given drive.
drive_game_clock_end: Game time at the end of a given drive.
drive_game_clock_start: Game time at the beginning of a given drive.
drive_inside20: Offense was able to get inside the opponents 20 yard line.
drive_play_count: How many regular plays happened in a given drive.
drive_play_id_ended: Play_id of the last play in the given drive.
drive_play_id_started: Play_id of the first play in the given drive.
drive_quarter_end: Indicating in which quarter the given drive has ended.
drive_quarter_start: Indicating in which quarter the given drive has started.
drive_real_start_time: Local day time when the drive started (currently not used by the NFL and therefore mostly 'NA').
drive_start_transition: Indicating how the offense got the ball.
drive_start_yard_line: Indicating where a given drive started consisting of team half and yard line number.
drive_time_of_possession: Time of possession in a given drive.
drive_yards_penalized: How many yards the offense gained or lost through penalties in the given drive.
end_clock_time: Game time at the end of a given play.
end_yard_line: Indicating the yardline at the end of the given play consisting of team half and yard line number.
ep: Using the scoring event probabilities, the estimated expected points with respect to the possession team for the given play.
epa: Expected points added (EPA) by the posteam for the given play.
extra_point_prob: Predicted probability of the posteam scoring an extra point.
extra_point_result: Result of the extra point attempt: good, failed, blocked, safety (touchback in defensive endzone is 1 point apparently), or aborted.
fantasy: Name of the rusher on rush plays or receiver on pass plays.
fantasy_id: ID of the rusher on rush plays or receiver on pass plays.
fantasy_player_id: ID of the rusher on rush plays or receiver on pass plays (from official stats).
fantasy_player_name: Name of the rusher on rush plays or receiver on pass plays (from official stats).
fg_prob: Predicted probability of the posteam scoring a FG next. 'Next' in this context means the next score in the same game half.
field_goal_result: Result of field goal attempt: made, missed, or blocked.
first_down: Play ended in a first down.
first_down_pass: Passing play converted the first down.
first_down_rush: Running play converted the first down.
fixed_drive: Manually created drive number in a game.
forced_fumble_player_1_player_id: One of the players with a forced fumble.
forced_fumble_player_1_player_name: One of the players with a forced fumble.
forced_fumble_player_1_team: Team of one of the players with a forced fumble.
forced_fumble_player_2_player_id: One of the players with a forced fumble.
forced_fumble_player_2_player_name: One of the players with a forced fumble.
forced_fumble_player_2_team: Team of one of the players with a forced fumble.
fourth_down_converted: First down was converted on fourth down.
fourth_down_failed: Posteam failed to convert first down on fourth down.
fumble_recovery_1_player_id: One of the players with a fumble recovery.
fumble_recovery_1_player_name: One of the players with a fumble recovery.
fumble_recovery_1_team: Team of one of the players with a fumble recovery.
fumble_recovery_1_yards: Yards gained by one of the players with a fumble recovery.
fumble_recovery_2_player_id: One of the players with a fumble recovery.
fumble_recovery_2_player_name: One of the players with a fumble recovery.
fumble_recovery_2_team: Team of one of the players with a fumble recovery.
fumble_recovery_2_yards: Yards gained by one of the players with a fumble recovery.
fumbled_1_player_id: First player who fumbled on the play.
fumbled_1_player_name: One of the first player who fumbled on the play.
fumbled_1_team: Team of one of the first player with a fumble.
fumbled_2_player_id: Second player who fumbled on the play.
fumbled_2_player_name: One of the second player who fumbled on the play.
fumbled_2_team: Team of one of the second player with a fumble.
game_half: Indicating which half the play is in, either Half1, Half2, or Overtime.
game_id: Ten digit identifier for NFL game.
game_stadium: Name of the stadium the game was played in. (Source: Pro-Football-Reference).
goal_to_go: Posteam is in a goal down situation.
half_sack_1_player_id: First player who recorded half a sack.
half_sack_1_player_name: First player who recorded half a sack.
half_sack_2_player_id: Second player who recorded half a sack.
half_sack_2_player_name: Second player who recorded half a sack.
home_coach: First and last name of the home team coach. (Source: Pro-Football-Reference).
home_opening_kickoff: Home team received the opening kickoff.
home_score: Total points scored by the home team.
home_timeouts_remaining: Timeouts remaining in the half for the home team.
home_wp: Estimated win probability for the home team.
home_wp_post: Estimated win probability for the home team at the end of the play.
id: ID of the player in the 'name' column.
is_catchable_ball: Catchable ball (defined by throws that are generally on target that are not defended away).
is_contested_ball: Contested ball (defined by whether or not the receiver is facing physical contact at the time of the catch).
is_created_reception: Created reception (defined by a reception that only occurs due to an exceptional play by the receiver).
is_motion: Motion occurred on the play before or at the time of the snap.
is_qb_fault_sack: Sack that is the fault of the quarterback.
jersey_number: Jersey number of the player listed in the 'name' column.
kick_distance: Distance in yards for kickoffs, field goals, and punts.
kickoff_fair_catch: Kickoff was caught with a fair catch.
kickoff_inside_twenty: Kickoff ended inside the twenty yard line.
lateral_interception_player_id: Unique indentifier for the player that received the lateral on an interception.
lateral_interception_player_name: Player that received the lateral on an interception.
lateral_kickoff_returner_player_id: Player that received the lateral on a kickoff return.
lateral_kickoff_returner_player_name: Player that received the lateral on a kickoff return.
lateral_punt_returner_player_id: Player that received the lateral on a punt return.
lateral_punt_returner_player_name: Player that received the lateral on a punt return.
lateral_receiver_player_id: Player that received the last (!) lateral on a pass play.
lateral_receiver_player_name: Player that received the last (!) lateral on a pass play. If there were multiple laterals in the same play, this will only be the last player who received a lateral. Please see <https://github.com/mrcaseb/nfl-data/tree/master/data/lateral_yards> for a list of plays where multiple players recorded lateral receiving yards.
lateral_receiving_yards: Yards by the player who received the lateral on a pass play.
lateral_recovery: Lateral occurred on a fumble recovery.
lateral_return: Lateral occurred on a return. Returns may occur on any of: interception, fumble, kickoff, punt, or blocked kicks.
lateral_rusher_player_id: Player that received the last (!) lateral on a run play.
lateral_rusher_player_name: Player that received the last (!) lateral on a run play. If there were multiple laterals in the same play, this will only be the last player who received a lateral. Please see <https://github.com/mrcaseb/nfl-data/tree/master/data/lateral_yards> for a list of plays where multiple players recorded lateral rushing yards.
lateral_rushing_yards: Yards by the player who received the lateral on a run play.
lateral_sack_player_id: Player that received the lateral on a sack.
lateral_sack_player_name: Player that received the lateral on a sack.
location: Either 'Home' o 'Neutral' indicating if the home team played at home or at a neutral site.
n_defense_box: Number of defenders in the box at the snap.
n_offense_backfield: Number of players in the backfield at the snap.
name: Name of the 'passer' if it is not 'NA', or name of the 'rusher' otherwise.
nfl_api_id: UUID of the game in the new NFL API.
nflverse_game_id: Game ID used by nflverse - built from season, week, home, and away teams.
nflverse_play_id: Play ID used by nflverse, corresponds to GSIS play ID.
no_huddle: Play was run with no huddle.
no_score_prob: Predicted probability of no score occurring for the rest of the half based on the expected points model.
opp_fg_prob: Predicted probability of the defteam scoring a FG next. 'Next' in this context means the next score in the same game half.
opp_safety_prob: Predicted probability of the defteam scoring a safety next. 'Next' in this context means the next score in the same game half.
opp_td_prob: Predicted probability of the defteam scoring a TD next. 'Next' in this context means the next score in the same game half.
order_sequence: Column provided by NFL to fix out-of-order plays. Available 2011 and beyond with source "nfl".
own_kickoff_recovery_player_id: Player that recovered their own kickoff.
own_kickoff_recovery_player_name: Player that recovered their own kickoff.
own_kickoff_recovery_td: Kicking team recovered the kickoff and scored a TD.
pass: Play was a pass play (sacks and scrambles included).
pass_attempt: Play was a pass attempt (includes sacks).
pass_defense_1_player_id: One of the players with a pass defense.
pass_defense_1_player_name: One of the players with a pass defense.
pass_defense_2_player_id: One of the players with a pass defense.
pass_defense_2_player_name: One of the players with a pass defense.
pass_location: Pass location: left, middle, or right.
pass_oe: Dropback percent over expected on a given play scaled from 0 to 100.
pass_touchdown: Play resulted in a passing TD.
passer: Name of the dropback player (scrambles included) including plays with penalties.
passer_id: ID of the player in the 'passer' column.
passing_yards: Yards by the passer, including yards gained in pass plays with laterals.
penalty_type: Indicating the penalty type of the first penalty in the given play. Will be NA if desc is missing the type.
penalty_yards: Yards gained (or lost) by the posteam from the penalty.
play_clock: Time on the playclock when the ball was snapped.
play_id: Play id that when used with game_id and drive provides the unique identifier for a single play.
play_type: Indicating the type of play: pass (includes sacks), run (includes scrambles), punt, field_goal, kickoff, extra_point, qb_kneel, qb_spike, no_play (timeouts and penalties), and missing for rows indicating end of play.
play_type_nfl: Play type as listed in the NFL source. Slightly different to the regular play_type variable.
posteam_score: Score the posteam at the start of the play.
posteam_score_post: Score for the posteam at the end of the play.
posteam_timeouts_remaining: Number of timeouts remaining for the possession team.
posteam_type: Indicating whether the posteam team is home or away.
punt_fair_catch: Punt was caught with a fair catch.
punt_inside_twenty: Punt ended inside the twenty yard line.
qb_dropback: QB dropped back on the play (pass attempt, sack, or scrambled).
qb_epa: Gives QB credit for EPA for up to the point where a receiver lost a fumble after a completed catch and makes EPA work more like passing yards on plays with fumbles.
qb_hit: QB was hit on the play.
qb_hit_1_player_id: One of the potential players that hit the QB. No sack as the QB was not the ball carrier. For sacks please see sack_player or half_sack_*_player.
qb_hit_1_player_name: One of the potential players that hit the QB. No sack as the QB was not the ball carrier. For sacks please see sack_player or half_sack_*_player.
qb_hit_2_player_id: One of the potential players that hit the QB. No sack as the QB was not the ball carrier. For sacks please see sack_player or half_sack_*_player.
qb_hit_2_player_name: One of the potential players that hit the QB. No sack as the QB was not the ball carrier. For sacks please see sack_player or half_sack_*_player.
qb_location: Pre-snap position of quarterback (U = under center, S = shotgun, P = pistol).
qtr: Quarter of the game (5 is overtime).
quarter_end: Marks the end of a quarter.
read_thrown: Which read in the quarterback's progression the throw was made to, using FTN's charting key: "0" = first (primary) read, "1" = second read, "2" = third read or later, "CHK" = checkdown, "DES" = designed read (throws with no progression, e.g. screens and many RPOs), "SD" = scramble drill (throw made after the play broke down). The "0" code is only used from 2023 onwards; in 2022 primary reads are not coded and appear as NA.
receiver: Name of the receiver including plays with penalties.
receiver_id: ID of the player in the 'receiver' column.
receiver_player_id: Receiver that was targeted on the pass.
receiving_yards: Yards by the receiver, excluding yards gained in pass plays with laterals.
replay_or_challenge_result: Indicating the result of the replay or challenge.
result: Equals home_score - away_score and means the game outcome from the perspective of the home team.
return_team: Return team. Returns may occur on any of: interception, fumble, kickoff, punt, or blocked kicks.
return_touchdown: Play resulted in a return TD. Returns may occur on any of: interception, fumble, kickoff, punt, or blocked kicks.
return_yards: Yards gained by the return team. Returns may occur on any of: interception, fumble, kickoff, punt, or blocked kicks.
roof: One of 'dome', 'outdoors', 'closed', 'open' indicating indicating the roof status of the stadium the game was played in. (Source: Pro-Football-Reference).
run_gap: Line gap of run: end, guard, or tackle.
run_location: Location of run: left, middle, or right.
rush_touchdown: Play resulted in a rushing TD.
rusher: Name of the rusher (no scrambles) including plays with penalties.
rusher_id: ID of the player in the 'rusher' column.
rushing_yards: Yards by the rusher, excluding yards gained in rush plays with laterals.
sack_player_id: Player who recorded a solo sack.
sack_player_name: Player who recorded a solo sack.
safety_prob: Predicted probability of the posteam scoring a safety next. 'Next' in this context means the next score in the same game half.
score_differential: Score differential between the posteam and defteam at the start of the play.
score_differential_post: Score differential between the posteam and defteam at the end of the play.
season: 4 digit number indicating to which season the game belongs to.
season_type: 'REG' or 'POST' indicating if the game belongs to regular or post season.
series: Starts at 1, each new first down increments, numbers shared across both teams NA: kickoffs, extra point/two point conversion attempts, non-plays, no posteam.
series_result: Possible values: First down, Touchdown, Opp touchdown, Field goal, Missed field goal, Safety, Turnover, Punt, Turnover on downs, QB kneel, End of half.
series_success: Series ended in a touchdown or a first down.
side_of_field: Which team's side of the field the team with possession is currently on.
solo_tackle: Play had a solo tackle (could be multiple due to fumbles).
solo_tackle_1_player_id: One of the players with a solo tackle.
solo_tackle_1_player_name: One of the players with a solo tackle.
solo_tackle_1_team: Team of one of the players with a solo tackle.
solo_tackle_2_player_id: One of the players with a solo tackle.
solo_tackle_2_player_name: One of the players with a solo tackle.
solo_tackle_2_team: Team of one of the players with a solo tackle.
special: Play was an extra point, field goal, kickoff, or punt.
special_teams_play: Play is a special teams play, per the NFL feed.
spread_line: Closing spread line for the game. A positive number means the home team was favored by that many points, a negative number means the away team was favored by that many points. (Source: Pro-Football-Reference).
st_play_type: Type of special teams play from NFL source. Available 2011 and beyond with source "nfl".
stadium_id: ID of the stadium the game was played in. (Source: Pro-Football-Reference).
start_time: Kickoff time in eastern time zone.
starting_hash: Hash the ball was place (L = left, M = middle, R = right).
success: EPA was positive on the play.
surface: What type of ground the game was played on. (Source: Pro-Football-Reference).
tackle_for_loss_1_player_id: One of the potential players with the tackle for loss.
tackle_for_loss_1_player_name: One of the potential players with the tackle for loss.
tackle_for_loss_2_player_id: One of the potential players with the tackle for loss.
tackle_for_loss_2_player_name: One of the potential players with the tackle for loss.
tackle_with_assist_1_player_id: One of the players with a tackle with assist.
tackle_with_assist_1_player_name: One of the players with a tackle with assist.
tackle_with_assist_1_team: Team of one of the players with a tackle with assist.
tackle_with_assist_2_player_id: One of the players with a tackle with assist.
tackle_with_assist_2_player_name: One of the players with a tackle with assist.
tackle_with_assist_2_team: Team of one of the players with a tackle with assist.
tackled_for_loss: Tackle for loss on a run play occurred.
td_prob: Predicted probability of the posteam scoring a TD next. 'Next' in this context means the next score in the same game half.
temp: Temperature at the stadium only for 'roof' = 'outdoors' or 'open'.(Source: Pro-Football-Reference).
third_down_converted: First down was converted on third down.
third_down_failed: Posteam failed to convert first down on third down.
time: Time at start of play provided in string format as minutes:seconds remaining in the quarter.
time_of_day: Time of day of play in UTC "HH:MM:SS" format. Available 2011 and beyond with source "nfl".
timeout: Timeout was called by either team.
total: Equals home_score + away_score and means the total points scored in the given game.
total_away_comp_air_epa: Cumulative total completions air EPA for the away team in the game so far.
total_away_comp_air_wpa: Cumulative total completions air WPA for the away team in the game so far.
total_away_comp_yac_epa: Cumulative total completions yac EPA for the away team in the game so far.
total_away_comp_yac_wpa: Cumulative total completions yac WPA for the away team in the game so far.
total_away_epa: Cumulative total EPA for the away team in the game so far.
total_away_pass_epa: Cumulative total passing EPA for the away team in the game so far.
total_away_pass_wpa: Cumulative total passing WPA for the away team in the game so far.
total_away_raw_air_epa: Cumulative total raw air EPA for the away team in the game so far.
total_away_raw_air_wpa: Cumulative total raw air WPA for the away team in the game so far.
total_away_raw_yac_epa: Cumulative total raw yac EPA for the away team in the game so far.
total_away_raw_yac_wpa: Cumulative total raw yac WPA for the away team in the game so far.
total_away_rush_epa: Cumulative total rushing EPA for the away team in the game so far.
total_away_rush_wpa: Cumulative total rushing WPA for the away team in the game so far.
total_away_score: Score for the away team at the start of the play.
total_home_comp_air_epa: Cumulative total completions air EPA for the home team in the game so far.
total_home_comp_air_wpa: Cumulative total completions air WPA for the home team in the game so far.
total_home_comp_yac_epa: Cumulative total completions yac EPA for the home team in the game so far.
total_home_comp_yac_wpa: Cumulative total completions yac WPA for the home team in the game so far.
total_home_epa: Cumulative total EPA for the home team in the game so far.
total_home_pass_epa: Cumulative total passing EPA for the home team in the game so far.
total_home_pass_wpa: Cumulative total passing WPA for the home team in the game so far.
total_home_raw_air_epa: Cumulative total raw air EPA for the home team in the game so far.
total_home_raw_air_wpa: Cumulative total raw air WPA for the home team in the game so far.
total_home_raw_yac_epa: Cumulative total raw yac EPA for the home team in the game so far.
total_home_raw_yac_wpa: Cumulative total raw yac WPA for the home team in the game so far.
total_home_rush_epa: Cumulative total rushing EPA for the home team in the game so far.
total_home_rush_wpa: Cumulative total rushing WPA for the home team in the game so far.
total_home_score: Score for the home team at the start of the play.
total_line: Closing total line for the game. (Source: Pro-Football-Reference).
two_point_conv_result: Result of two point conversion attempt: success, failure, safety (touchback in defensive endzone is 1 point apparently), or return.
two_point_conversion_prob: Predicted probability of the posteam scoring the two point conversion.
vegas_home_wp: Estimated win probability for the home team incorporating pre-game Vegas line.
vegas_home_wpa: Win probability added (WPA) for the home team: spread_adjusted model.
vegas_wp: Estimated win probabiity for the posteam given the current situation at the start of the given play, incorporating pre-game Vegas line.
vegas_wpa: Win probability added (WPA) for the posteam: spread_adjusted model.
weather: Describing the weather including temperature, humidity and wind (direction and speed). Doesn't change during the game!
wind: Speed of the wind in miles/hour only for 'roof' = 'outdoors' or 'open'. (Source: Pro-Football-Reference).
wp: Estimated win probabiity for the posteam given the current situation at the start of the given play.
wpa: Win probability added (WPA) for the posteam.
xpass: Probability of dropback scaled from 0 to 1.
xyac_epa: Expected value of EPA gained after the catch, starting from where the catch was made. Zero yards after the catch would be listed as zero EPA.
xyac_fd: Probability play earns a first down based on where the ball was caught.
xyac_mean_yardage: Average expected yards after the catch based on where the ball was caught.
xyac_median_yardage: Median expected yards after the catch based on where the ball was caught.
xyac_success: Probability play earns positive EPA (relative to where play started) based on where ball was caught.
yac_epa: EPA from the yards after catch alone. For completions this represents the actual value provided after the catch. For incompletions this represents the difference between the hypothetical air_epa and the play's raw observed EPA (how much the incomplete pass cost the posteam).
yac_wpa: WPA from yards after the catch (same logic as yac_epa).
yardline_100: Distance in the number of yards from the opponent's endzone for the posteam.
yards_after_catch: Distance in yards perpendicular to the yard line where the receiver made the reception to where the play ended.
yards_gained: Yards gained (or lost) by the possessing team, excluding yards gained via fumble recoveries and laterals.
ydsnet: Total yards gained on the given drive.
ydstogo: Yards in distance from either the first down marker or the endzone in goal down situations.
yrdln: Indicating the current field position for a given play.
